stations.title: Dougie
stations.say: When is the stretcher due a check?

stations.title: Kit sheet
stations.text: Dates as text, counted on fingers.

stations.title: Dougie
stations.say: Due in April. No fingers needed.
stations.note: And the council gets it in full.

captions: In the kit store, Dougie asks when the stretcher is next due a check.
Today the dates are text on a sheet, and Dougie counts the days on his fingers.
You turn the text into dates, count days between them, add days and write report lines.
Now the laptop counts the days since the stretcher's check and gives the date it is due.
Dougie knows when every check is due, and the council gets each date written out in full.
